name: Volunteer at Mercy Medical Center Merced
org: Dignity Health (CommonSpirit), Mercy Medical Center Merced
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors. You might greet and guide visitors, do office tasks, help move patients, keep patients company, or work in gift shops. Duties differ by place.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older. Mercy Medical Center in Merced is a listed place to volunteer.
deadline_text: The page does not say whether applications are open now. Ask Volunteer Services.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer interest form. The volunteer team then contacts you about an interview and orientation. You also need a background check and shots.
notes: This is the Central California system volunteer page. It lists no phone number, so use the contact page at commonspirit.org/dignity-health-central-cal-contact-us. The page does not say whether applications are open, so ask before you plan on it.
